# Project custom instructions

## Code style
- Use React with functional components and hooks.
- Use TypeScript types and interfaces for component props and data models.
- Prefer semantic and accessible markup.
- Keep styling modular and responsive.

## Behavior
- Implement features with clean state management and event handling.
- Validate user input and prevent empty task creation.
- Keep code readable with descriptive names and concise functions.

## Accessibility
- Include labels for form controls.
- Use accessible button text and ARIA attributes where needed.
- Ensure focus states are visible.

## Documentation
- Keep README up to date with install and launch instructions.
- Refer to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` when making project-wide changes.
